description.text: Near-total darkness fills a broad, empty showroom at the far end of the hall. A black sports car waits there, its carbon fibre body catching only a thin rim of light along the roofline and flanks, while the polished floor holds faint grey reflections beneath it. The space ahead is open and uncluttered; the car is a low, dark shape at the edge of visibility. After a beat, the headlights snap on, throwing two pale beams across the empty hall and making the nearby floor gleam. The car begins to creep forward out of the black, nose first, tyres barely whispering at first, as the surrounding darkness starts to slide behind it.
A black sports car waits in near-total darkness at the far end of an empty showroom floor, a thin rim of light tracing its carbon fibre body.
The headlights snap on and the car begins to creep forward out of the dark.
A deep ignition thump is followed by a low engine rumble.
Tyres whisper faintly across the polished showroom floor.
The camera holds a static shot.

The shot cuts to a closer medium-wide view as the black sports car rolls forward out of the darkness into the showroom lighting. Its carbon fibre body resolves in long, clean highlights along the hood and doors, and the empty polished floor opens around it as it advances. The car moves steadily toward the center of the hall, then eases to a stop, settling centered in the full showroom composition. The final image matches the anchored last frame exactly: the complete supplied picture, with its existing layout, background, car placement and lighting preserved without cropping, isolating a panel or redrawing the scene.
The black sports car rolls out of darkness into the showroom lighting, its carbon fibre body resolving as it advances.
The engine note rises as the car accelerates forward.
Tyres roll to a stop on the polished floor.
The car settles centered on the empty showroom floor, matching the anchored final frame.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
